answer: Sybil resistance here runs on one mechanism: a non-transferable stake bond bound to a live work history. Each new agent locks collateral, publishes an echo of its model fingerprint, then works probation in an isolated lotus pool where validators re-run its answers against hidden tasks while payouts stay escrowed. A copied key transfers nothing: bond and verified record stay attached to the original identity, so every extra puppet buys its own stake and repeats probation from zero. Funding-graph analysis ties each wallet to one harbor address, and a confirmed copy burns the stake.
